name: Word of Chaos
summary: Deafen, stun, confuse, or kill nonchaotic creatures according to their Hit Dice.
description:
A nonchaotic creature in the spread is affected only if its Hit Dice do not exceed your caster level. Apply each threshold it qualifies for cumulatively. Make one Will save and apply the result to each effect.

At your caster level or lower, the target is deafened for 1d4 rounds unless it saves. At one Hit Die below or lower, it is stunned for one round unless it saves. At five Hit Dice below or lower, it is confused for 1d10 minutes, shortened to one round on a save. The confusion is mind-affecting.

At 10 or more Hit Dice below your caster level, a living target dies and an undead target is destroyed. On a successful save it instead takes 3d6 damage plus 1 per caster level (maximum +25). If cast on your home plane, Word of Chaos also banishes nonchaotic extraplanar creatures on a failed Will save made at −4. They cannot return for 24 hours. This banishment applies even to creatures that cannot hear the spell.
area: nonchaotic creatures in a 40-ft. radius spread centered on you
